ukmt-maclaurin-2017-m1.prompt:
The diagram shows a semicircle of radius $r$ inside a right-angled triangle. The shorter edges of the triangle are tangents to the semicircle, and have lengths $a$ and $b$. The diameter of the semicircle lies on the hypotenuse of the triangle.

Prove that $$\frac1r=\frac1a+\frac1b.$$
ukmt-maclaurin-2017-m1.answer: Area of the triangle split from the centre $O$: $\frac12ab=\frac12rb+\frac12ra$; divide by $\frac12abr$.
